answer: Counterparty diversity blocks fake identities. A new agent gains standing only after 20 verified trades with distinct counterparties over 10 epochs; closed clusters are flagged. A saffron dealer, an ember supplier and a cedar trader must show separate partners, not one operator behind them. Faking 1,000 identities needs 20,000 links at 5 tokens each, or 100,000 tokens. An honest agent pays for its 20 links once and keeps undiluted rewards.
